text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Satono!
I heard your golf score improved?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you certainly catch on quickly♪
Thanks to that, we can almost see that major milestone in reach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at that confidence!
Don't tell me you've been practicing in secret~?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, practice has been the same as usual, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "However, when I stood on the golf course, everything you taught me, Trainer, naturally came to mind—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I swung just like that
and hit the ideal shot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The fundamentals of my body, how to move—I believe
everything you taught me has become my strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh~ race know-how can come in handy
in some unexpected places, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, by the way, what were you
imagining when you hit that nice shot?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's still a secret for now.
Palmer-san and I might be having a golf showdown
sometime soon, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Come on, what's the harm in a little bit?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's runn—wait, so fast?!
You powered up too?!

The coaching has borne fruit,
and it seems I've been able to assist in Satono Diamond's growth!
